notes.title: Just 2 days left before the release of Make Your Kingdom on January 20!
notes.notes:
Is this the real life? Is this just fantasy? Make Your Kingdom will be released in just 2 days! You will be able to dive into the exciting process of creating your own kingdom starting January 20th.

In Make Your Kingdom can play as a founder of the settlement. And like any kind and righteous ruler you can not only help your people win the battles, but also take part in constructing any buildings, gathering and transporting the resources, and just checking on your fellow residents! Long live the King! 👑

How often do you play as a founder? Some players don’t seem to use this feature, but others seem to dig it a lot. What about you?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33942180/e720b547047861640aa062d9008ec2330c8044ff.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Just 3 days left before the release of Make Your Kingdom on January 20!
notes.notes:
We can't wait! Make Your Kingdom will be released in just 3 days! You will be able to dive into the exciting process of creating your own kingdom starting January 20th.

Today we have a little preview of the new models on this beautiful screenshot — can you notice the new things and changes to some other buildings? The most noticeable change is probably the main building's design — what do you think of it? 

The release date is coming closer and closer and we can't wait to see all the beautiful kingdoms that you'll build!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33942180/9e9b996530bbec813c770e5d7bf193ac43da2003.png[/img]

notes.title: Just 5 days left before the release of Make Your Kingdom on January 20!
notes.notes:
You heard it here first, folks! Make Your Kingdom will be released in just 5 days! You will be able to dive into the exciting process of creating your own kingdom starting January 20th.

Do you remember this roadmap (https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1257560?emclan=103582791466659002&emgid=3827447881812034416) that we posted a while back? We completed almost everything out of this list! There will be a lot more buildings than in the demo and some will even have multiple looks so you could make your settlement even more diverse. There will also be a few completely new mechanics - like talking to your fellow settlers and motivating them. One of the new mechanics that will make the game a bit harder is sickness. (Some settlers will inevitably get sick, but just one hospital and a healer's house will be able to turn it all around.) We hope that you also enjoy the new interface which you could’ve seen during the last playtest. Plus there will also be helpful tip windows that should make learning how to play the game easier for new players.

And while we wait for the release countdown to finally be over, share with us - what Is your favorite thing about the game? We love to see your comments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33942180/810dc75e2c3a03edddbc585e8f088d5b1097a7b8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Just 6 days left before the release of Make Your Kingdom on January 20!
notes.notes:
The wait is almost over – Make Your Kingdom will be out on Steam in just 6 days! You will be able to dive into the exciting process of creating your own kingdom starting January 20th. 🥳

It’s been 4 years of hard work – and almost everything you’ll see in the game was developed by one person! The developer (yo_serjio) has done a great job of improving the game since the demo was released in the summer of 2020 - new mechanics and building models have been added to the game, and the user interface has been changed completely.

And while we wait for the release countdown to finally be over, share with us – how did you find out about the game? We would love to hear your stories! ❤

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33942180/0ad8256a8e219a0b6fcdcfdade48dd1f07107781.png[/img]

notes.title: Make Your Kingdom Open Pre-release Playtest launches today!
notes.notes: We have some great news to share - Make Your Kingdom Open Pre-release Playtest launches today! You can join the playtest by pressing the "Request access" button on the main page of the game under the "Join the Make Your Kingdom playtest" sign. We're hoping to receive some feedback on the current stage of the game so we could make the release version as polished as it can be. Feel free to share your opinions and thoughts via Steam, Discord or the ingame form, we really appreciate it. Have a great time testing the game!

notes.title: New Game Mechanics and Release Date
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello, founders![/h2]
We have some big news. 

For the last 3 years, we've been working tirelessly on Make Your Kingdom to make it the best low-poly kingdom ruler simulator in its genre - with interesting management and elaborate settlement building. All to fulfill our dream and give you a game you'll really like.

Previously we planned to release the game at the end of July 2021, which is very soon. But after extensive testing of Make Your Kingdom, we realized that the game needs to be improved. So we have to push back the release date, but not for long - Make Your Kingdom will be out within the next two months! 

We want to be honest with you, so we will tell you what kind of improvements the game needs. Over the next few weeks, we will be adding to the game mechanics of changing the appearance of the houses - now most buildings will have 2-3 different looks. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33942180/a816fdf41c8f7beea6b945c91c8a5dff016a61bd.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33942180/c1bfdf7af0bf40fd4a93567932536cd6fa6d1001.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33942180/4828c244e9b1a40b73f40b1809ac61e9c2115155.jpg[/img]

In addition to dozens of new visuals, we need to test the technical part of this mechanic to avoid bugs and incorrect visuals. In addition, we will continue to catch bugs, so that the release of Make Your Kingdom will give you only pleasant emotions!

Thank you for staying with us! Without your support and attention, we wouldn't have made it this far. There's not much left and we're looking forward to MYK's release just as much as you are.

Don't forget to join our Make Your Kingdom community on Discord for exclusive development news before anyone else: https://discord.gg/YJPHUBWU 
And subscribe to our Twitter feed: https://twitter.com/make_kingdom

notes.title: Make Your Kingdom Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello Founders! 

Make Your Kingdom is in its final stages of development. We've finished working on the core gameplay, visuals, and are now catching bugs, checking stability, and improving the interface.

That's why it's time to put a red date on the calendar - July 29, 2021! 

On that day, the city-building low-poly simulator Make Your Kingdom will be available to players. At last you will build a settlement, make it a successful kingdom, protect it from the raids of orcs, make the settlers happy, survive the winter and become a true Founder.

So, July 29, your PC, you and Make Your Kingdom. See you soon!

Don't forget to join the Make Your Kingdom community on Discord to get exclusive development news before anyone else: https://discord.gg/RKwRyER
And subscribe to Twitter: https://twitter.com/make_kingdom
